audit-locales.name: audit-locales
audit-locales.description: Audit and compare translation keys across locale files (e.g. zh-CN vs en-US)

args.name: target
args.description: Target locale directory to compare against (default: locales/en-US)

pre-push-check.name: pre-push-check
pre-push-check.description: Pre-push security & quality gatekeeper: scans secrets, audits dependencies, and flags code smells

args.name: lang
args.description: Output language for CLI messages: en-US | zh-CN (default: auto-detected)

args.name: strict
args.description: Fail (exit 1) on code smell or dependency warnings

args.name: json
args.description: Output gatekeeper report in JSON format

blast-radius.name: blast-radius
blast-radius.description: Code Symbol Graph & Blast-Radius analysis: evaluate impact scope and affected tests before refactoring

args.name: target
args.description: Target file path or symbol identifier to analyze

adversary-check.name: adversary-check
adversary-check.description: Adversarial Red-Team Code Auditor: scans diffs for missing transactions, non-hermetic tests, greedy regexes, and dirty VCS artifacts

args.name: staged
args.description: Audit staged git diff instead of latest commit
